lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: name: vitadeck-build

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: description: Builds the JS runtime (pnpm in js/), then vitadeck for the host (CMake + raylib) and for PSVita in the Vitasdk Docker Compose service. Use when editing vitadeck C/native or JS/deck-app code, verifying desktop and Vita targets, producing out/vitadeck or out-vita/vitadeck.vpk, or when the user mentions macOS build, PSVita, VPK, VITASDK, docker-compose vitasdk, or js/dist.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: metadata:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: internal: true

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # vitadeck dual-target build

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Prerequisites

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **JavaScript workspace** (run before native builds; CMake copies `js/dist/runtime` into `<build>/js/`):

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Node.js 22+ (Rolldown uses Node 22+ APIs)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Dependencies once: `pnpm --dir js install`

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Produce runtime bundle and example `.vdapp` packages: `pnpm --dir js build` → writes `js/dist/runtime/runtime.js` and `js/examples/*/dist/*.vdapp`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Typecheck: `pnpm --dir js tsc`; lint/format: `pnpm --dir js lint` / `pnpm --dir js format`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Host (current machine)** — e.g. macOS:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - CMake 3.10+

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - [raylib](https://www.raylib.com/) via Homebrew: `brew install raylib`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - CURL, OpenSSL, and zlib (typical on macOS; CMake `find_package` must succeed)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **PSVita** — no local Vitasdk install required:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Docker with Compose

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Repo root must contain `docker-compose.yml` (service `vitasdk` mounts the repo at `/build/git`)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Quick start

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: From the **vitadeck repository root**, in order:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: **1. JS** (stages runtime under `js/dist/runtime/`; examples build to `js/examples/*/dist/*.vdapp`):

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: pnpm --dir js install

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: pnpm --dir js build

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **2. Host** (executable `out/vitadeck`):

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: cmake -S . -B out && cmake --build out

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **3. PSVita** (artifacts under `out-vita/`, including `vitadeck.vpk` when packaging is enabled):

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: docker-compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake -S . -B out-vita && cmake --build out-vita"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Workflows

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### Canonical agent checks

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: From the repo root, prefer the tiered verification script:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `scripts/agent-check.sh fast`: JS typecheck, JS lint, and C formatting check.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `scripts/agent-check.sh host`: JS build, host configure/build, and non-smoke CTest.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `scripts/agent-check.sh smoke`: host build plus visual smoke CTest.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `scripts/agent-check.sh full`: fast, host, smoke, and Vita Docker build.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### After JS, TSX, or deck-app changes

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 1. `pnpm --dir js build` (and `pnpm --dir js tsc` when checking types).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 2. Rebuild host: `cmake --build out` (or full configure if CMake changed).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 3. Rebuild Vita: `docker-compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake --build out-vita"` (or full configure in the container if CMake changed).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### After C or CMake changes

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - C sources under `src/` use **clang-format** (`.clang-format` at repo root; editor: **clangd** with format-on-save). Check: `./scripts/clang-format.sh check`; apply: `./scripts/clang-format.sh format`. Run `cmake -S . -B out` so `out/compile_commands.json` exists for clangd.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 1. Ensure `js/dist/` is current — run **`pnpm --dir js build`** if JS sources changed or after a clean.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 2. Rebuild host: `cmake --build out` (or full configure line if `CMakeLists.txt` changed).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 3. Rebuild Vita: `docker-compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake --build out-vita"` (or full configure inside the container if CMake changed).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### Clean or switch generators

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Host: remove `out/` and re-run JS step if needed, then configure + build.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Vita: remove `out-vita/` inside the same `docker-compose run ... bash -lc "..."` pattern, then configure and build again.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### Verify both targets

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Run **JS build**, then the host quick start, then the Vita quick start. Fix compile errors on each target separately — `CMakeLists.txt` branches on `VITASDK` for Vita vs raylib for host.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Notes

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - In the container, `VITASDK` is set by the image; the project picks the Vita toolchain when that env var is present.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Host builds use `out/`; Vita builds use `out-vita/` on the **host** filesystem (bind-mounted from the container).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Host only: `cmake --build out --target stage_examples` copies every built `js/examples/*/dist/*.vdapp` into `out/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps`; `cmake --build out --target run` builds, stages, and launches `out/vitadeck`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - CMake can invoke JS via the `js_build` target; for agent workflows, treat **`pnpm --dir js build` before native builds** as the normal prerequisite so `js/dist/` is explicit and up to date.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **`vitadeck`** CLI is a compiled **`js/packages/sdk/dist/cli.mjs`** (plus **`dist/templates/`**); **`pnpm --dir js install`** runs the workspace **`prepare`** script, which builds **`@vitadeck/sdk`**.
